gloss: A city and seaport in the Russian Far East, on the Sea of Japan, near North Korea; the administrative centre of Primorsky Krai.
A weblog using video as its primary presentation format.
A content creator, regardless of whether or not they make vlogs.

A transliteration of the Bulgarian, Macedonian, Pannonian Rusyn, Russian, or Serbo-Croatian male given name Владимир (Vladimir), equivalent to Volodymyr, popular throughout the history of Slavic countries and societies.
A male given name from Russian, but rare as a name of English-speaking persons.
A city, the administrative centre of Vladimir Oblast, Russia.
An oblast and federal subject of Russia.
The head of church and state in Montenegro until 1852; the prince bishop.
A major river in the Czech Republic, tributary of the Elbe.
